summary: Legacy arguments.callee in a non-strict mapped arguments object denotes the currently executing function and requires a JS function-object representation.

target.notes: Supporting this legacy property requires the arguments object to retain the exact current function object; it also interacts with property redefinition/deletion.

semantics.value: current function object in mapped legacy arguments object

caveats: Deprecated legacy feature; do not substitute a generated C# method handle if JS function identity/properties are observable.
